distinguishing_features: Active, feedback-controlled fluid gap modulation via a secondary fluid reservoir and metering valve
Direct damping of hydrodynamic pressure fluctuations without altering roll geometry
Use of out-of-phase pressure modulation to break phase-locking in self-excited friction-induced waves
Configuration change in hydraulic circuit to enable real-time film thickness control
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to suppress periodic gloss bands caused by roll barring in a paper calender without removing the roll or grinding its surface, while adapting to varying operating conditions
parsed.viable_reason: The mechanism relies on established EHL physics and uses standard hydraulic components capable of microsecond-scale response, making real-time film modulation feasible.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: The application of active fluid film modulation to disrupt self-excited frictional instabilities in rolling contact is not a routine extension of prior monitoring or passive design-change approaches.
